prompt.content: Who issued the final report on Filegate in 2000, stating that there was no credible evidence of any criminal activity by any individual in the matter?

output: The final report on the Filegate scandal issued in 2000 by the United States House of Representatives stated that there was no credible evidence of any criminal activity by any individual in the matter. The report was issued by the Committee on Government Reform, chaired by then-Representative Bob Barr (R-GA).
